name: Gemini CLI
statusNote: Google states that, for unpaid-tier and Google One users, Gemini CLI was replaced by Antigravity CLI on 18 June 2026, and that it is not optimised for the newest Gemini model.
summary: Google's open-source command-line agent for Gemini, now replaced by Antigravity CLI for unpaid users.
description: Gemini CLI is Google's open-source agent that brings Gemini models into the terminal for coding and other tasks, with extensions. Google states that, for unpaid-tier and Google One users, Gemini CLI was replaced by Antigravity CLI on 18 June 2026, and that it is not optimised for the newest Gemini model. Plans include a free tier, Google AI Pro and API-key use.

features: Google's open-source command-line agent for Gemini, now replaced by Antigravity CLI for unpaid users.
Gemini CLI is Google's open-source agent that brings Gemini models into the terminal for coding and other tasks, with extensions.
Google states that, for unpaid-tier and Google One users, Gemini CLI was replaced by Antigravity CLI on 18 June 2026, and that it is not optimised for the newest Gemini model.

features_fr: L'agent de ligne de commande open source de Google pour Gemini, désormais remplacé par Antigravity CLI pour les utilisateurs non rémunérés.
Gemini CLI est l'agent open source de Google qui intègre les modèles Gemini dans le terminal pour le codage et d'autres tâches, avec des extensions.
Google déclare que, pour les utilisateurs non rémunérés et Google One, Gemini CLI a été remplacé par Antigravity CLI le 18 juin 2026 et qu'il n'est pas optimisé pour le dernier modèle Gemini.
Les forfaits incluent un niveau gratuit, Google AI Pro et l'utilisation des clés API.
